notes: The two «ح» routes each write «الأعمش» in their own names, so each is its own group and the tail is null (rule 3).
«- واللفظ له -» is an editor gloss and is left out.
«قيل له قد علمكم نبيكم» — a passive question inside the saying («قيل»); no transmitter is named, and the answer «أجل» is Salman's own words, so Salman is the last link.
